build_check.description: index.html and game_logic.js exist, a canvas/WebGL renderer is present, and no disallowed heavy runtime asset references are used.

requirements.description: A 30-second countdown timer governs each loop. When it expires, time rewinds and the player restarts at the spawn point. The timer is visible and counts down during gameplay. Score 0 if no time loop mechanic exists.

After a loop ends, a ghost of the previous loop replays simultaneously during the next loop. The ghost physically interacts with the world — pressing buttons, holding doors, blocking lasers. Multiple ghosts (up to 4) can be layered from successive loops. Score 0 if no ghost replay exists.

Switches, pressure plates, and doors require sustained activation — a ghost standing on a plate keeps it pressed for the duration of its replay. The player must coordinate timing across loops so ghosts hold switches at the right moments. Score 0 if no sustained-activation elements exist.

Reaching the exit crystal with all required conditions met (switches held, paths cleared) completes the level. The exit is only accessible when ghost cooperation enables it. Score 0 if no exit condition exists or exit is always accessible.

A reset button clears all recorded ghosts to start a level fresh. A timeline bar shows all active ghosts and their current positions within the 30-second window. Score 0 if no reset or timeline visualization exists.
At least 16 levels across 4 chapters are present. Early levels require only 1-2 ghosts, later levels require 3-4 ghost layers with precise timing coordination. Score 0 if fewer than 8 levels exist.

Multiple interactive element types exist: pressure plates, toggle switches, timed doors, laser blockers, moving platforms activated by switches, and conveyor belts. At least 4 distinct element types. Score 0 if only one interactive element type exists.

Chapters introduce mechanics progressively: Chapter 1 teaches single-ghost cooperation, Chapter 2 adds timing-critical elements, Chapter 3 introduces multi-ghost puzzles, Chapter 4 combines everything. Score 0 if no progressive difficulty exists.

Some levels have multiple valid solutions using different ghost configurations. Optional challenges exist for completing levels in fewer loops than the minimum required. Score 0 if all levels have exactly one solution.
Level completion shows loops used, time of exit within the final loop, and a rating. A chapter-select screen shows progress and ratings per level. Score 0 if no completion tracking exists.
A styled title screen shows overlapping clock imagery and ghost silhouettes with the game name. A chapter menu is accessible. Score 0 if the game starts directly in gameplay or uses raw default UI.
The game flow connects title -> chapter select -> level -> loop cycles -> completion -> back to select without restarting. Score 0 if transitions are missing.
During gameplay, the 30-second countdown, timeline bar with ghost positions, active ghost count, and interactive element states (on/off) are clearly visible. Score 0 if no HUD exists.

Readability at 1280x720 is strong: the player, ghosts (each visually distinct or numbered), switches, doors, lasers, and exit crystal are all clearly distinguishable. Score 0 if elements blend together.

The art direction is coherent across title, levels, ghosts, interactive elements, and UI — a consistent temporal/clockwork aesthetic with unified palette. Score 0 if mostly default UI or mismatched placeholders dominate. Full credit may be earned with runtime-authored procedural textures, layered materials, deliberate multi-light rigs, particles, synthesized audio, or post-processing; external asset files are not required.

Level environments use real sprite or tile art for platforms, switches, doors, and backgrounds — not plain ColorRect fills. Ghosts have a distinct translucent or temporal visual treatment. Score 0 if environments are uniform color fills.

HUD and UI chrome: countdown timer, timeline bar, chapter select, and completion screens use styled themed widgets — not raw unstyled HTML 引擎 defaults. Score 0 if primary UI elements are obviously unstyled.

Animation and feedback: time rewind has a visual rewind effect, ghosts shimmer or pulse, switches animate on activation, the exit crystal glows when accessible, and loop transitions have temporal distortion effects. Score 0 if all state changes snap silently.
